in_arabic.name: أمينول

in_english.name: Aminul
in_english.meaning: Believers in Allah and His Messenger
in_english.long_meaning: Aminul: Those who believe in Allah and His Messenger, and follow the commands of Allah and His Messenger. They are the ones who establish the foundations of Islam, and work to spread the message of Islam, and to establish the correct foundations of Islam in the society. They are the ones who believe in the Oneness of Allah, and the Prophethood of Muhammad, and the Holy Quran, and they work to establish the correct foundations of Islam in their lives, and to spread the message of Islam to others, and to work for the betterment of the Ummah. They are the ones who believe in the hereafter, and the accountability of their actions, and they work to live a life of righteousness, and to avoid the evil deeds, and to work for the betterment of the society.
